sections.brief: The documented life of Cyrus I. Scofield to 1909: 7th Tennessee enlistment, Chimborazo, alienage discharge 26 Sep 1862, Union oath at Bowling Green (18 Nov 1862), 1903 Southern Cross of Honor; marriage to Leontine Cerre 1866; Kansas House 1871-72; US Attorney 19 Mar-20 Dec 1873, DOJ 'forced to resign'; forgery complaints 1877-78, St. Louis jail from 8 Oct 1878, nolle prosequi 6 Nov 1879; desertion and one divorce (1883); conversion 1879, licensed 1880, ordained Oct 1883, Dallas 1882-95; no degree, self-styled D.D.; Trumbull's 1920 account set beside the record. Figures: time; compare

Rumours tested with verdicts: convicted/imprisoned (fails; jailed awaiting trial holds), Canadian prison (fails), twice divorced (fails), Antietam hero (fails) vs deserter (partly holds), D.D. (no degree), Kansas resignation (holds; specific crimes unproven), Lotos Club/Untermyer (membership holds; sponsorship, contact, money fail; Canfield's 'we assume'; chain to Piper 2004; trope named; funders to ts5_funding); what biography can and cannot prove.
